hero.title: Village-Level Committees
hero.description: Information about the various committees working for village development and their contact details.

intro.title: Committees for Village Development
intro.description: Village-level committees support local development by addressing important community needs through planning, coordination and public participation.
intro.messageTitle: Working Together for a Better Village
intro.messageDescription: Each committee plays an important role in improving village services, resolving local issues and supporting the well-being of residents. Citizens are encouraged to cooperate with committee members and take part in community initiatives.

committees.title: Village-Level Committees
committees.description: Meet the committees, learn about their responsibilities and find the contact details of their chairpersons.

waterSanitation.title: Water Supply and Sanitation Committee
waterSanitation.description: Plans and manages water distribution in the village and coordinates cleanliness initiatives.

disputeResolution.title: Mahatma Gandhi Dispute-Free Committee
disputeResolution.description: Helps resolve minor and major local disputes amicably within the village through mutual understanding.

healthNutrition.title: Village Health and Nutrition Committee
healthNutrition.description: Monitors healthcare services, vaccination activities and efforts to eliminate malnutrition.

schoolManagement.title: School Management Committee
schoolManagement.description: Looks after the quality of the Zilla Parishad school and the facilities provided to students.

womenChildWelfare.title: Women and Child Welfare Committee
womenChildWelfare.description: Works towards women's empowerment, supports self-help groups and oversees Anganwadi-related activities.

disasterManagement.title: Disaster Management Committee
disasterManagement.description: Coordinates assistance and relief activities during floods, fires and other natural disasters.

committees.note: For assistance or further information, please contact the respective committee chairperson.

responsibilities.title: Key Responsibilities of Committees
responsibilities.description: Committees work together to support essential village services, community welfare and local development.

items.planning: Planning and coordinating village-level development activities.
items.publicParticipation: Encouraging public participation and cooperation in community initiatives.
items.monitoring: Monitoring local services and identifying issues that need attention.
items.coordination: Coordinating with residents and relevant authorities to address community needs.

participation.title: Your Participation Makes a Difference
participation.description: Active citizen participation, cooperation and communication help village committees work effectively and make development initiatives more successful.

commitment.title: Together for a Stronger Village
commitment.description: Let us work together with our village committees to promote cooperation, improve local services and build a healthy, clean and progressive village.
